First release of **Alter**: run separate copies of any Windows app, each with its own sign-in, settings, icon and taskbar button.

### Download
**Alter.zip** below. Extract it anywhere, then double-click **Alter.exe**. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway** (Alter isn't signed).

See the [README](https://github.com/ffrusdev/alter#how-to-use-it) for how to use it.

### In this release
- Make copies of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, VS Code, Slack, Discord, Notion, Claude and most other apps
- Each copy gets its own data folder, letter tile or icon, taskbar button, and Desktop / Start Menu shortcut
- Launch and Stop copies from one window, and see which are running
- Microsoft Store apps through their launch aliases (for example the Claude desktop app)
- Follows apps that move to a new folder on every update (Discord, Slack)
- Needs Windows 10 or 11; nothing to install
